section.before:
### node 项目网站无法启动&访问
无法启动可能是：
1. 没有安装较新版本的 node，在项目管理页面中，node 版本中显示所有版本安装一个较新的 LTS 即可
   ![[Pasted image 20250818153643.png]]
2. 没有安装项目的模块
   ![[Pasted image 20250818153723.png]]
3. 项目配置问题
   ![[Pasted image 20250818153747.png]]
   默认项目目录是 `www/wwwroot`，运行用户为 www，如果修改项目目录为其他，需要**注意运行用户是否有权限**访问运行目录中文件，如果运行用户是 www，而项目目录在其他用户的文件夹中，就可能会出现错误无法启动。
```error
启动失败npm error code ENOENT npm error syscall open npm error path /www/server/panel/package.json npm error errno -2 npm error enoent Could not read package.json: Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '/www/server/panel/package.json' npm error enoent This is related to npm not being able to find a file. npm error enoent npm error Log files were not written due to an error writing to the directory: /www/server/nodejs/cache/_logs npm error You can rerun the command with `--loglevel=verbose` to see the logs in your terminal
```
